_note: Hand-transcribed after an automated coordinate parse was attempted and ABANDONED: it reconstructed 4 of 52 rows and misassigned 2 of those (Eric Dickerson to LINEBACKERS, Uwe von Schamann to DEFENSIVE BACKS). A silently wrong position is exactly the failure this project keeps catching, so the table was read instead.

ud-1985-01-14.citation: University Daily, 14 January 1985, p.10, reprinting a Dallas Morning News listing
ud-1985-01-14.headline: NFL players enjoyed 25 percent salary raise in 1984
ud-1985-01-14._attribution_correction: Report 14 gave this as 2 removes (UD <- DMN). The page byline reads 'By The Associated Press', so it is THREE removes, the same chain as the Pampa News story. Corrected here.
ud-1985-01-14.convention_quote: Figures reflect 1984 base salary, reporting and roster bonuses and signing bonus pro-rated over the length of the contract. For example: Detroit's Billy Sims signed a 5-year contract with a $1 million bonus. His 1984 salary was $600,000; his pro-rated signing bonus is $200,000 a year. In the listing, his salary is listed at $800,000. Many of the contracts contain large sums of deferred money, which reduces the present value.

figures.block_reason: The layout places this row adjacent to the LINEBACKERS heading in a neighbouring column. Assigned to RUNNING BACKS on three grounds: it continues the block's descending sequence exactly (580,000 -> 550,000 -> 500,000); Dickerson was a running back; and RUNNING BACKS is otherwise 4 entries where every other block has 5 or 6.
same as Dickerson - continues the descending sequence and Wilder was a running back

figures_on_a_different_convention.quote: the $450,000 annual base salary recently negotiated for defensive tackle Randy White
figures_on_a_different_convention.note: the SAME man in the SAME season on TWO conventions - base 450,000 and base+prorated 570,000. The clearest possible demonstration of why they are different predicates.

shapiro-1979-02-10.citation: Leonard Shapiro, The Washington Post, syndicated in the Midland Reporter-Telegram, 10 February 1979, p.9
shapiro-1979-02-10.convention_quote: The Management Council's dollar figures ... did not include performance (incentive) clauses or playoff money.
shapiro-1979-02-10.convention_note: INFERRED that signing bonuses are pro-rated: Shapiro does not say so, but Newman 1987 Appendix C states the Management Council pro-rates them, and these figures are Management Council-computed. Flagged rather than assumed.

figures.quote: is believed to have earned $141,870 in 1978 to lead defensive backs
is believed to have earned $105,000 in 1978 according to NFL sources

cohort_figures.quote: the average NFL salary rose 13.2 perent - from $55,000 in 1977 to $62,585 in 1978

shapiro-1979-02-10._deltas_not_ingested: The positional increases (QB +$13,000, OL +$8,000, LB +$8,000, DL +$7,000, DB +$7,000, K +$7,000, WR +$6,000, RB +$2,000) are DELTAS, not levels. There is no predicate for a year-on-year change and inventing one to hold them would invite them being read as salaries. Left out deliberately and recorded here.
